name: Render, compare and refine
when: A constructed layout hypothesis is available for comparison with reference images.
procedure: Render the current construction using the supplied reference-camera settings when available.
Identify the most consequential visible mismatch and distinguish identity, position and orientation explanations.
Adjust a limited set of permitted pose parameters, then render and compare again.
verification: The revised construction better explains available reference evidence without omitting objects or changing fixed sizes.
failure_lessons: A plausible arrangement is not sufficient if it differs from the target; do not scale objects to fit projections.
adaptation_notes: Original task-specific refinement card based on the official Layout workflow.
